currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only;no bespoke survey sources or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected elevated west/front view: unequal square towers,short north clock/crenellation tower and tall southern open belfry;three pale front portico arches/balustrade,central patterned upper front/tall window,terracotta nave roof,low green north-gallery roof/long arcade,high eastern square sanctuary and green pitched transept roofs. Cloister has tiled roof ring/paired columns and open square court. Surrounding low monastery ranges are retained as approximate massing;exact urban house detail is outside the model.

Inspected eastern apses: large round central apse with two stacked pointed-arcade tiers,small neighboring round apse,tall narrow windows,alternating pale/dark bands,round medallions and selected geometric inlay fields. Round apse roof is low/conical. Motif rhythm is simplified geometry/tints sharing stone materials;exact carved/inlay patterns are excluded.
